caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug with a flared base and a pronounced, thick handle that has a decorative spiral at the upper and lower attachment points. The mug is rendered in grayscale, with shading indicating its cylindrical form and metallic texture. The mug features an octagonal engraved border on its side, within which the word "Mug" is written in cursive script. The composition centers the mug on a plain background, with a rectangular border framing the entire drawing. The artist's signature, "Joseph Wolf," appears in the bottom right corner inside the border. The shading is concentrated mostly to the left of the mug, creating the effect of a light source from the right.
title: Britannia Mug
